# Objective

We have default query filters now, but there is no first-party marker for entity disabling yet
Fixes #17458

## Solution

Add the marker, cool recursive features and/or potential hook changes should be follow up work

## Testing

Added a unit test to check that the new marker is enabled by default
pr_comments: I think that this should close that issue. Would you mind fixing the description? :)

issue_context.title: Add a first-party `Disabled` component
issue_context.body: With https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/13120 merging, it's important that we ship a simple `Disabled` unit struct and register it as a default query filter to make sure this feature is useful to beginners out of the box.
comments: You'll need mutable access to get a `ComponentId`. I would probably add the standard default query filters in `World::bootstrap()`, but we need to be sure that defining custom DQF works too.

review_comments: Should we update the module docs to mention that the `Disabled` component is disabled in the default `DefaultQueryFilters`?  Right now they talk about it as a hypothetical.
It will be nice when resources-as-components lets us use default query filters to exclude the default query filters resource from our resource query :).
I think it might be worth adding a comment explaining that the DefaultQueryFilters modify the access and would make the test harder to reason about

I'm a bit worried that users might do a 
```app.init_resource::<DefaultQueryFilters>()``` 

and lose the `Disabled` functionality inadvertently..

`init_resource` doesn't overwrite existing resources. You'd have to explicitly call `.insert_resource(DefaultQueryFilters::default())` which is probably verbose enough to make it obvious what will happen. Currently it is intended that you can opt-out of entity disabling, but as the feature matures we could consider making it so that it is always there.
